title_en: Supreme People's Court Notice on Issuing the Regulations on Resignation for Cause by Presidents and Vice-Presidents of Local People's Courts at Various Levels and Special People's Courts (Trial Implementation)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Printing and Distributing the Regulations on the Responsibility Resignation of Presidents and Vice-Presidents of Local People's Courts and Special People's Courts (Trial Implementation)

Fa Fa [2001] No. 21

To all local people's courts at various levels nationwide, all railway transport intermediate courts and basic courts, all maritime courts, and courts at various levels of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

The Regulations on the Responsibility Resignation of Presidents and Vice-Presidents of Local People's Courts and Special People's Courts (Trial Implementation) are hereby printed and distributed to you for earnest implementation. Any issues encountered during implementation shall be promptly reported to this Court.

This document is simultaneously copied to the Party committees, People's Congresses, Discipline Inspection Commissions, and Political and Legal Affairs Committees of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government. Please have each higher people's court deliver these copies on behalf of this Court.

November 6, 2001

Regulations on the Responsibility Resignation of Presidents and Vice-Presidents of Local People's Courts and Special People's Courts (Trial Implementation)

Article 1 These Regulations are formulated in accordance with the Judges Law of the People's Republic of China and the Provisions on the Implementation of the Responsibility System for the Construction of Party Conduct and Clean Government of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council, in line with the principle of the Party managing cadres, and in light of the actual work of the courts, for the purposes of deepening the reform of the cadre system, improving the management system for leading cadres of the courts, and ensuring that leading cadres of the courts faithfully and lawfully perform their duties.

Article 2 These Regulations apply to presidents and vice-presidents of local people's courts at various levels and special people's courts.

Article 3 "Responsibility resignation" refers to the act by which a president or vice-president who bears direct leadership responsibility voluntarily resigns from his or her current position due to a failure to perform or correctly perform duties within the scope of his or her direct jurisdiction, resulting in a major work error or serious consequences.

Article 4 A president or vice-president who, within the scope of his or her direct jurisdiction, falls under any of the following circumstances shall voluntarily submit a resignation:

(1) A serious case of perversion of justice in adjudication occurs in the court, causing significant losses to national interests, public interests, or the lives and property of the people, or resulting in vicious impact;

(2) Other major disciplinary or illegal cases occur in the court that are concealed and not reported, or are refused to be investigated and dealt with, resulting in serious consequences or vicious impact;

(3) Due to negligent supervision in equipment or administrative management, a major accident occurs or significant economic losses are caused;

(4) Other circumstances where it is inappropriate to continue serving as president or vice-president.

Article 5 A president or vice-president who assumes responsibility resignation shall submit a written resignation application to the Party committee with authority over cadre management and the higher people's court. After the Party committee consults with the higher people's court and obtains its consent, the resignation shall be processed in accordance with statutory procedures.

Article 6 If a president or vice-president who falls under any of the circumstances specified in Article 4 of these Regulations does not submit a resignation, the Party committee with authority over cadre management shall, after consulting with the higher people's court and obtaining its consent, propose to the People's Congress or its Standing Committee to recall, remove, or dismiss the person from his or her position in accordance with statutory procedures.

Article 7 After a president or vice-president resigns from his or her position, an alternative assignment may be arranged based on the reasons for the resignation and the individual's personal circumstances, and the corresponding rank and treatment shall be determined.

Article 8 These Regulations do not apply to presidents or vice-presidents who have already been decided to be removed from office or who have already been subjected to sanctions of removal from office or above.

Article 9 For a president or vice-president who assumes responsibility resignation and needs to be subjected to Party discipline or government disciplinary sanctions below the level of removal from office (excluding removal from office), the matter shall be handled in accordance with relevant regulations and the cadre management authority.

Article 10 The interpretation of these Regulations shall be the responsibility of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 11 These Regulations shall take effect on a trial basis as of the date of promulgation.
